expr: String((() => { const folds=[...document.querySelectorAll('.tree .fold')]; let n=0; folds.forEach(f=>{ if(f.innerText==='▸'){ f.click(); n++; } }); return JSON.stringify({foldsBefore:folds.length,expanded:n}); })())

String((() => { const sl=document.querySelector('.pane.left .scroll'); const r=sl.getBoundingClientRect(); return JSON.stringify({label:'组织树',h:Math.round(r.height),sh:sl.scrollHeight,ch:sl.clientHeight,ofy:getComputedStyle(sl).overflowY,visibleRows:document.querySelectorAll('.tree .row').length}); })())
